Stanley Capital Management Lifted Its Anthem (ANTM) Position; Rockwell Automation (ROK) Holder Lombard Odier Asset Management Switzerland Sa Has Increased Its Holding
May 15, 2018 - By Linda Rogers
Stanley Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Anthem Inc (ANTM) by 8.75% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Stanley Capital Management Llc bought 3,500 shares as the company’s stock declined 2.73% with the market. The institutional investor held 43,500 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $9.79M, up from 40,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Stanley Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Anthem Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $58.89B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.68% or $1.57 during the last trading session, reaching $230.74. About 489,130 shares traded. Anthem, Inc. (NYSE:ANTM) has risen 35.30% since May 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 23.75% the S&P500.
Lombard Odier Asset Management Switzerland Sa increased its stake in Rockwell Automation Inc (ROK) by 112.41% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Lombard Odier Asset Management Switzerland Sa bought 8,847 shares as the company’s stock declined 10.98% with the market. The institutional investor held 16,717 shares of the capital goods company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $3.28M, up from 7,870 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Lombard Odier Asset Management Switzerland Sa who had been investing in Rockwell Automation Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $22.31 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.67% or $1.2 during the last trading session, reaching $177.66. About 381,589 shares traded. Rockwell Automation Inc. (NYSE:ROK) has risen 13.32% since May 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 1.77% the S&P500.
